item.content:encoded:
Residents interested in learning the art of apiculture are invited to attend a free introductory beekeeping workshop at the Saline County Fairgrounds this August.

The event will offer beginners a comprehensive overview of the practice, led by local experts from Southern Yankee Homestead. Read more below.




The workshop is scheduled to take place on Tuesday, August 18th, beginning at 6 p.m. at the Saline County Fairgrounds.

Hosted by Southern Yankee Homestead, this educational session is tailored specifically for beginners with little to no prior experience. Instructors will guide attendees through the fundamental basics of beekeeping, providing the foundational knowledge needed to safely start and maintain a healthy bee colony.

Admission to the workshop is completely FREE and open to the public. Anyone interested in attending or seeking more information about the event is encouraged to call or text the organizers at 501-860-3773.
